note: lead = seconds of picture before the voice starts; tail = seconds after it ends. Chapters dissolve into each other.

scenes.name: intro
scenes.narration: YouTube has some of the best teachers in the world. Vortex gives you a way to learn from them.

scenes.name: courses
scenes.narration: Real courses, built from real lessons. Every video in the right order, and credited to the creator who made it.

scenes.name: search
scenes.narration: Just ask, in plain English. Vortex finds the lesson, and the moment it's taught.

scenes.name: progress
scenes.narration: Your place is saved to the second. So you can pick up right where you left off.

scenes.name: quiz
scenes.narration: When a video ends, a short quiz checks what stuck. Retake it until you pass.

scenes.name: plan
scenes.narration: And for anything else, just describe your goal. Vortex builds you a plan.

scenes.name: close
scenes.narration: Vortex. Learn anything, the way a course teaches it.
